explanation: Implemented all four b04 edits using the pinned source revision. The API diagrams distinguish programmable mutation gating, socket context-upload permission, and independent AI-runtime checks. Selection diagrams add shared pointer recognition, latched ownership, single-commit marquee completion, and copy dependencies. Existing responsibilities and attachment labels remain intact; all diagrams fit their preceding bounds, including the runtime's exact 48-node budget. These boundaries support later selection and gesture refinements without depicting those features as implemented.

Unified Selection Ownership
|-- CanvasSession -> SelectionState: semantic membership
|   |-- items[]: ordered unique id / displayNodeId
|   `-- region?: absent = whole diagram; else captured context
|       `-- rectangle / sourceContentId / revision / ASCII / node IDs
|-- SelectionCommands: one application mutation path
|   |-- replace / add / toggleDiagram / selectRegion / remove / clear
|   `-- Shared rules
|       |-- Whole diagram and its selected regions exclude each other
|       |-- Deselect restores no regions; duplicates reuse identity
|       `-- Panel visibility does not determine membership
|-- Input adapters
|   |-- CanvasSelectionLayer -> SelectionGestureController
|   |   |-- Mouse / pen / touch; screen-pixel slop: 4 / 4 / 10
|   |   |-- Mouse Ctrl-drag: add; node tap: add region
|   |   |-- Pen Select: marquee; Hand: pan; tap selects hit
|   |   |-- Direct policy: add flag or replace; UI passes replace
|   |   |-- Touch: temporary Hand pan/pinch; no selection tap
|   |   `-- Multiple contacts cancel; blocked until all leave
|   |-- NativeSelectionOwnership: application/native latch
|   |   |-- Keep owner after DOM up through native settlement
|   |   |-- Next intentional native hit/drag can claim native
|   |   `-- Application claim prevents native selection overwrite
|   |-- Native Editor owns live shapes; MappingEditorRuntime.settle
|   |   |-- captureSelection=true: changed IDs replace membership
|   |   |-- false: keep domain selection; restore native diagram IDs
|   |   `-- commitEditorGesture records settled selection/layout
|   |-- Domain whole-diagram membership projects to native IDs
|   |-- Mouse double-click diagram: replace; Ctrl/Meta: toggle
|   `-- Explicit deselect: clear; panel source action: saved region
|-- GesturePreview: temporary pointer / marquee / promotion state
|   |-- Pointer-up -> completeMarquee -> one controller.updateCanvas
|   |   `-- Add/replace diagrams + regions; reuse IDs/surfaces; focus
|   `-- Cancel discards preview; tool/blur/escape cleanup
|-- Consumers read domain SelectionState
|   |-- Canvas highlights / count / toolbar; move / code / chat
|   |-- Copy: focused captured region rect + selected node IDs
|   |   `-- selectionClipboardText: full indented rows + code refs
|   `-- WebSocket serializer: diagramIds + regions
|       |-- Region IDs / source / rectangle / text / stale
|       `-- Initial snapshot + deltas -> server mirror -> readers
|-- UI interaction state: action-menu / keyboard focus
|-- PanelState: independent lifetime
|   |-- Code / chat / projection panels; captured source context
|   `-- Layout / expansion / focus survive selection removal
`-- Delete selected diagrams: one controller semantic update
    |-- Remove diagrams, incident edges and unused content/sections
    |-- Remove owned region panes and selection membership
    `-- Prune surfaces/thread focus; undo restores checkpoint state
